title: The White Kite
lines: A big gust lifts it up and up.
The kite lands in a tall pine.
Tall Jill rolls up on a bike.
Jill grabs the kite from the pine.
"Get on," Jill tells Mike with a smile.
Mike and Jill ride for a mile.

questions.listenFor: In a tall pine tree. If they say "a tree," that counts, but ask which line told them so.
She is tall enough to grab the kite. Listen for the reason she could reach it, not just "she got it."

questions.ask: Do you think Mike and Jill are pals? Tell me why.
questions.listenFor: Either answer is fine. You are listening for a reason from the story, like "yes, she gave him a ride."
